The '''Big Crush''' was an event that happened in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and resulted in the destruction of one of the planets in the [[Taspan system]]. It was caused by an accident with the [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]] technology the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was developing there. At the time of the [[Battle of Mindor]] the [[Unidentified debris field|remains of the planet]] had not yet settled into stable orbits, making travel in the system extremely dangerous. As computed by one of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] analysts, his task force would have lost two ships after only an hour in the system just from [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] impacts.

The Big Crush was temporarily of great benefit to the [[Melter]]s living in [[Taspan II]]'s crust, scattering them and letting them absorb and feed on stellar radiation more easily. Luke, in communion with them, understood this to have been a brief [[Golden Age of Paradise|Golden Age]].
